notes.title: Patchnotes (Build 83)
notes.content:
New Features:
- the entries of the last played games now have a replay button
- players can now register for upcoming tournaments. more information about the tournament system will follow soon.

notes.title: Patchnotes (Build 82)
notes.content:
New Features:
- 2 steam achievements have been added
- notifications are now sent when receiving or completing quests
- season 1 avatars have been added
- you can now purchase bomb skins with gold
- players can now continue to chat with each other after a game is finished

Bugfixes:
- when selecting a chat message that has already been written (with arrow up/down while writing message), the caret position is now set to the end
- number of bombs should now be set correctly

notes.title: Patchnotes (Build 80)
notes.content:
New Features:
- a double-click option for cells is now available in the settings

Bugfixes:
- whispers are working correctly now
- game results in player profiles should now display correctly
- players are now leaving queue if they join or create a room
- players are now leaving rooms if they go offline, queue up or start/spectate a game
- after a reconnect, the players should no longer be able to read the chat messages of spectators
- players can now click open fields if they are using the bomb ability
- ai name in replays should now be displayed correctly

notes.title: Patchnotes (Build 76)
notes.content:
New Features:
- a tutorial can now be found in the game
- at the beginning a field is opened automatically to give the players a fair start

Bugfixes:
- in some cases the timer was wrong in the game
- the cpu usage should no longer be so high
- as soon as you have received a chat message, other views have also scrolled down
- the ladder should now only display players in all tabs who have played at least one ranked game
- challenging a friend several times in a row should no longer work now
- player profiles should now only show games from the current season

notes.title: Patchnotes (Build 75)
notes.content:
New features:
- server restart notification in chat
- update available notification in chat on login
- whispers (format: /w playername message)
- reply to whisper (format: /r message)
- afk/inactive indicator for player states

Bugfix:
- not playing a turn in unranked games now changing turn correctly
- players who played the beta but did not play ranked games have now been removed from the hall of fame

We will soon be giving away a special gift to the beta testers. Stay tuned!
